newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Stora Q1 profit seen 65 pct down.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Stora Q1 profit seen 65 pct down.

text.p: Swedish forestry company Stora was expected to post a sharply lower pre-tax profit of 429 million crowns for the first quarter of 1997, a Reuters poll of 11 analysts found on Friday.
In the same period a year ago Stora posted a profit of 1.22 billion crowns.
Forecasts for the first quarter of the year varied between 290-590 million crowns.
For full year 1997 analysts expected to see a profit of 2.37 billion crowns. Profit per share was estimated on average at 4.90 crowns.
Stora will release its first quarter report on April 24.
Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aros, Aragon, Enskilda, Handelsbanken, Goldman Sachs, Penser, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Norske Bank, Salomon Brothers, Swedbank and Societe Generale.
